title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Desk Guidance: Choosing the Tier and the Payer
content:
For every ADAS Sensor Calibrations order, the tier follows the systems to calibrate and the payer follows the source the order was opened for.

## The tier

The tier follows the systems to calibrate:

| Systems to calibrate on the order | Manufacturer procedure recorded on the order for the camera | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| Forward camera alone | dynamic | Dynamic Camera Calibration |
| Forward camera alone | static | Static Camera Calibration |
| Forward camera alone | static and dynamic | Dual-Mode Camera Calibration |
| Blind spot radar alone | — | Blind Spot Radar Calibration |
| Front radar alone | — | Front Radar Calibration |
| Two or more systems (of forward camera, front radar, blind spot radar and surround-view camera) on the same order | — | Multi-System Calibration |

Each system on the order must be fitted to the vehicle according to the vehicle's recorded driver-assistance package.

The tier fixes which sensors are included in the order: whether the forward camera, a radar sensor and surround-view cameras are calibrated within it.

## The payer

The payer follows the source:

| Source of the order | Payer |
|---|---|
| Glass replacement paid under an insurer's glass program | That glass program, where the tier's glass-program billing term is yes; the customer otherwise |
| Collision repair on an insurance claim | Paid through that repair order (the insurer, via the repair) |
| Customer-pay repair | The customer; a fleet account receives the tier's fleet discount percentage |
| Customer request | The customer; a fleet account receives the tier's fleet discount percentage |
| Warranty rework | Billed according to the tier's warranty rework billing term |

## Worked readings (hypothetical orders)

- An order lists a forward camera only, and the manufacturer procedure recorded for the camera is static and dynamic: the tier is Dual-Mode Camera Calibration.
- An order lists a forward camera and a blind spot radar: two systems, so the tier is Multi-System Calibration, whatever procedure is recorded for the camera.
- A glass replacement under an insurer's glass program leads to an order whose tier's glass-program billing term is no: the order is billed to the customer.
- A calibration follows a collision repair on an insurance claim: it is paid through that repair order, not by the customer.
